newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Yanhua IPO priced at HK$1.78 - SBC Warburg.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Yanhua IPO priced at HK$1.78 - SBC Warburg.

text.p: The issue price of H-shares in Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Ltd has been fixed at HK$1.78 per share, SBC Warburg, one of global co-ordinators of the issue, confirmed on Monday.

Officials from SBC Warburg said the issue price of the H-shares for the international placement portion was fixed at HK$1.78, compared with the indicative price range of HK$1.70 to HK$2.70 for the international placement portion.

Shares in the Hong Kong public offering portion are also fixed at HK$1.78 per share, inclusive of brokerage and transaction fees, they said. The indicative price range of for the Hong Kong tranche was from HK$1.68 to HK$2.25.

The Chinese resins and plastics producer is due to make an official statement announcing the subscription results on Tuesday. Dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin in New York on June 24 and in Hong Kong on June 25.
SBC Warburg and Bear, Stearns & Co Inc are the global coordinators of the issue.
Beijing Yanhua issued 1.012 billion new H-shares, or 30 percent of its enlarged share capital, in a global offering of the company's shares.
